description: Source file implementing classes and methods related to waveform processing in EFI control software, including classes SingleWave and MultiWave with functions for managing switch times and channel states.

classes.name: SingleWave
classes.description: Represents a single waveform with methods to get and set pin states.

classes.name: MultiWave
classes.description: Handles multiple waves, managing switch times and channel states with methods for validation and retrieval.

methods.name: SingleWave::SingleWave
methods.description: Constructor initializing SingleWave object, optionally with pin states.

methods.name: SingleWave::init
methods.description: Initializes SingleWave with provided pin states.

methods.name: SingleWave::getState
methods.description: Returns the state of a pin at a specific switch index.

methods.name: SingleWave::setState
methods.description: Sets the state of a pin at a specific switch index.

methods.name: MultiWave::baseConstructor
methods.description: Shared constructor logic initializing channels and switch times.

methods.name: MultiWave::MultiWave
methods.description: Overloaded constructor initializing with switch times and waves, invokes baseConstructor and init.

methods.name: MultiWave::getSwitchTime
methods.description: Returns switch time at specified index.

methods.name: MultiWave::checkSwitchTimes
methods.description: Validates that switch times are properly ordered and last entry is 1.

methods.name: MultiWave::getChannelState
methods.description: Retrieves the state of a specific channel and phase.

methods.name: MultiWave::findInsertionAngle
methods.description: Finds the insertion point for a given angle in the switch times array.

methods.name: MultiWave::findAngleMatch
methods.description: Finds a matching angle in switch times, returns error code if not found.

methods.name: MultiWave::setSwitchTime
methods.description: Sets switch time at specified index, with assertion check.
